subject: Promo approval chain review — Velvet AI repeated trial grant requests
body:
From: Samir Khan <samir@velvet.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We had a few teams spin up evaluation clusters overnight and have burned through the initial pilot credit allotment faster than expected. Would Redwood consider an additional one-time allocation of 150k token credits to complete a 48-hour micro-benchmark across three models? This is for Velvet AI's internal infra evaluation; we are not sharing access externally.

I can sign any paperwork or accept trial terms for auditing if needed — just want to keep momentum.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform
Velvet AI

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Folks — forwarding Samir's ask. Can Sales Ops confirm whether this account has previously received extensions or top-ups? I pulled a quick account snapshot (attached) that suggests multiple trial increments in the last 90 days, but want Ops/Trust data before we respond.

I want to avoid approving repeated goodwill grants without a compliance check. If there’s a pattern of multiple accounts or overlapping trials, we should escalate to policy enforcement.

- Laura
VP, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: account_snapshot_20261119.pdf]

-----
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Laura — I pulled logs from Sales Ops and Trust. See attached CSV for the last 6 months of trial/grant events tied to the Velvet AI org and associated email domains. Quick summary:

- There are 4 separate top-up events labeled as promotional/grant for velvet.ai domains between 2026-08-02 and 2026-11-05.
- Two of the events are tied to different HubSpot company records but share overlapping billing contact emails and the same billing address.
- We have a spike in token usage coming from three distinct API keys that map to accounts created within a 48-hour window.

My read: high likelihood of coordinated account creation to extend pilot capacity. Recommend we mark this for Fraud Review and deny unconditional auto-grant. We could offer a conditional, time-limited extension if Legal/Trust approve.

Attachments: trial_request_log.csv

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Ops (Americas)
Redwood Inference

-----
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Agree with Stephanie. A few proposed next steps:

1) Run device/IP heuristics across the three API keys to see if requests funnel through the same egress points. If so, treat as single logical actor.
2) Check for promo-code usage and whether the same promo was used across different accounts.
3) If the account is strategic (large potential ARR), Product + Sales can consider an exception with an abbreviated POC contract and short-term limited credits tied to milestone acceptance.

If Trust flags it, I suggest the external reply be firm but constructive: decline the blanket grant and offer a guarded path (one-time 50k token offer with acceptance of monitoring and a POC MSA).

-Markus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khan <samir@velvet.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Hi Samir —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. We want to make sure we balance speed with platform security and policy. Before we can approve a large additional allocation, our Trust team needs to complete a short review of account history and usage patterns. We did find multiple prior top-ups tied to velvet.ai-related records which requires a quick verification.

We can do two things in parallel:
- If you can share the project/cluster IDs and the contact who set up the pilot, that will speed the review.
- Alternatively, we can offer a one-off, conditional 50k token credit while Trust completes the audit. That credit would be time-limited (7 days) and subject to monitoring for scripted/federated activity. If monitoring shows abuse, we will suspend further grants and preserve the right to revoke credits.

If you'd like to pursue the conditional path, reply and confirm the cluster IDs and authorize the monitoring. If you'd rather pause until the audit completes, we will prioritize review and get back within 48 hours.

Best,
Laura
VP, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Samir Khan <samir@velvet.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits for evaluation cluster

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear next steps. We will accept the conditional 50k token credit and authorize monitoring. Cluster IDs: velvet-test-01, velvet-test-02, velvet-interop-3. Pilot owner: Priya Rao (priya@velvet.ai), who you can contact for any verification. We appreciate the one-time support and will keep usage within the stated scope.

Best regards,
Samir
Head of Platform
Velvet AI
